- [2023/05/28] The user is analyzing clauses 3.1, 3.7, 3.8, and 8.9.3 of a construction contract, focusing on compaction and testing requirements.
- [2023/05/28] Beckhaus argued a conflict between clauses 3.8 and 8.9.3, but it was determined that both clauses required compliance with different minimum standards.
